title: spt ∂X ⊆ spt X
statement: For all N, k ∈ ℕ and every X ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^N) (GeometricCurrentOn univ (k + 1)), (SB) spt ∂X ⊆ spt X. Here ∂X = X.boundary, (∂X)(ω) = X(dω), and spt S = S.support = univ \ S.zeroRegion.
lean_statement: ∀ (N k : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) (k + 1)), X.boundary.support ⊆ X.support
